zero_based.why: keeps page() counting from 0, as the code had it, and only adds the range check

no_lower_bound.why: counts from 1 but leaves the range to slicing, so page -1 wraps round to items from the end

raises.why: raises IndexError for a page out of range, where the chat said it never raises

last_page_dropped.why: off by one at the top: treats the last page as past the end
